text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn to 60.0 mm diameter x 20 mm; bore 6 mm (a close fit on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft). The diameter sets the scale: 188.5 mm of wire per turn.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a helical groove 1 mm pitch and 0.5 mm deep over 7 mm of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the width, centred, with the lathe set to screw-cut 1 mm pitch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 1 mm anchor hole at the start of the groove for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wire end, and an M3 set screw hole into the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the 6 mm shaft beside the spring motor, set screw on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shaft flat. The wire leaves the drum straight up under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the eyelet: the drum's right-hand edge is under the eyelet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wind the 1,000 mm wire on in a single layer, in the groove.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: runs true within 0.05 mm; the wire lies in the groove

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in one layer with the arm at the full 939 mm stroke.
